verdicts.reason: The quote states the legal range (1 to 255, default 4) of a parameter. That is checkable by exercising legal values, not with check=none. Scenario fits better. The out-of-range case is covered by SPI-4-03.

SCLK = f(i_clk)/(2·D) is stated in the quote. Measuring the SCLK period over multiple cycles is better done in a scenario/measurement than as a per-cycle assertion over interface signals. Strength MUST and actor system are fine.
REQ-PAR-001 states it directly. Elaboration failure is exercised by a scenario.
REQ-PAR-002 states it directly. It is exercised by sweeping values from 1 to 255.

duplicates.reason: Both come from the same quote, but SPI-4-01 states the legal range and SPI-4-02 states the frequency formula. They differ in requirement, so they should not be merged.

questions.question: SPI-4-02 and SPI-4-04: At D=1, is SCLK = f(i_clk)/2 achievable with every timing relation (setup/sample edges) in the spec? Is any minimum D implied by the data-path timing?
